units.source_text: 灌肠是阿作来过两三天之后的事了。

en.t: The enema was done two or three days after Osaku had come.

units.source_text: 父亲高兴地说：“真是多亏了医生，现在舒服多了。”

en.t: Father said happily, "It really is thanks to the doctor; I feel much better now."

units.source_text: 父亲对自己的寿命似乎有了些信心，心情也开朗了。

en.t: Father seemed to gain some confidence about his own span of life, and his mood brightened too.

units.source_text: 在一旁的母亲，不知是受了父亲情绪的影响，还是为了鼓舞病人，

en.t: Mother, who was beside him, whether influenced by Father's mood or trying to encourage the patient,

units.source_text: 把先生来电报的事告诉了他，说得就好像已经如父亲所愿，我在东京找到了工作似的。

en.t: told him about the telegram from Sensei, speaking as though, just as Father wished, I had already found work in Tokyo.

units.source_text: 我在一旁急得抓耳挠腮，可又不能阻止母亲，只得默不作声地听着。

en.t: I was beside myself with anxiety, but I could not stop Mother, so I had no choice but to listen in silence.
A smile appeared on the sick man's face.

units.source_text: “那可太好了。”妹夫也高兴地笑着说。

en.t: "That is wonderful," my brother-in-law also said, smiling happily.

units.source_text: “什么工作，还不知道吗？”哥哥问。

en.t: "What kind of work is it? You still do not know?" my elder brother asked.

units.source_text: 事已至此，我连否认的勇气也没有了，

en.t: At this point I no longer even had the courage to deny it,

units.source_text: 便含含糊糊地应对了几句，找借口离开了病人的房间。

en.t: so I answered vaguely a few times, made an excuse, and left the sickroom.
